_readme: HELD-OUT paraphrase battery -- provenance matters more than the content.
question_variants.json was written by the same person who then fixed the
router against it, so its score is an upper bound, not an estimate. These
45 questions were written by a separate agent that was given only the 11
public sample questions, the taxonomy, the commercial-name list and the
definitions of the intent labels -- and was explicitly forbidden from
reading src/surgvu/router.py, tests/test_router.py or the other fixture.
It never saw a rule, so it could not have been written around one.
Same schema as question_variants.json, minus the perception scenarios:
